"TO THE SKY" ENCAPSULATES OUR BRAND'S ETHOS OF LIMITLESS ASPIRATION AND BOUNDARY-PUSHING CREATIVITY. ESTABLISHED IN TORONTO, CANADA, IN 2023, WE ARE A TESTAMENT TO DREAMING WITHOUT CONSTRAINTS, EMBODYING A GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE WHILE CHERISHING OUR ROOTS.

WE THRIVE BY AIMING FOR THE INFINITE. AU CIEL SIGNIFIES A MINDSET THAT TRANSCENDS LIMITS, AND IGNITES IMAGINATION. WE RETHINK THE POSSIBLE AND VENTURE BEYOND THE FAMILIAR TERRITORIES OF DESIGN AND CREATIVITY.

OUR SIGNATURE MINIMALIST SILHOUETTES NARRATE THE FUSION OF JAPANESE CULTURE WITH UNIQUE WEARABLE MOTIFS. EACH PIECE IS DESIGNED AS A MERGING OF WORLDS FROM FABRIC TO FINISH.

THIS ETHOS EMPOWERS US TO INSPIRE AND UNITE INDIVIDUALS AROUND A COMMON PASSION FOR ANIME-INFUSED FASHION, BLENDING THE BEST OF WESTERN AND JAPANESE CULTURES TO CRAFT GARMENTS THAT TELL A STORY, EVOKE EMOTION, AND CELEBRATE THE ART OF DESIGN.

WE CELEBRATE THE POWER OF CREATIVE EXPRESSION, RECOGNIZING ITS INFLUENCE AS A CATALYST FOR INNOVATION, CRITICAL THINKING, AND SOCIAL EVOLUTION. AU CIEL STANDS AS A BEACON FOR THOSE DARING TO EXPRESS THEIR DISTINCTIVENESS, OFFERING A CANVAS FOR THEIR PERSONAL AND COLLECTIVE NARRATIVES.

AU CIEL EXISTS TO CREATE A SPACE WHERE ARTISTS, DESIGNERS, AND FANS CAN COLLABORATE, SHARING THEIR VISIONS AND TALENTS WITH THE WORLD.

TOGETHER, WE ARE CRAFTING A GLOBAL MOVEMENT INSPIRED BY THE BOUNDLESS SKIES WORLDWIDE. WHERE DREAMS ARE WOVEN INTO THE FABRIC OF REALITY, AND EVERY GARMENT IS A BADGE OF HONOR FOR THOSE WHO DARE TO DREAM "TO THE SKY."
